templates.title: Claude Desktop · claude_desktop_config.json
templates.instructions: macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json — Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Claude Desktop only speaks stdio MCP, so the snippet uses the `mcp-remote` bridge (https://github.com/geelen/mcp-remote). Restart Claude Desktop after editing.
